candidate_download_source.rights_notes: The repository readme says CrossRefIndex is compiled from R. A. import_notes: Use scripts/prepare-tsk-metav-cross-references.mjs to convert MetaV Verses.csv and CrossRefIndex.csv into the app's JSON import shape. Then run scripts/import-tsk-cross-references.mjs after rights approval.
current_checkout_note: As of 2026-07-07, this repository checkout includes the TSK source manifest but not the MetaV source CSV files. Do not generate additional TSK rows until source files are restored or a public-domain TSK source file is selected and documented.
